Best for SMB sales teams that run a deal pipeline and want a cheap per-seat CRM with an open API.

## Rate limits

Two layers. (1) Daily token budget per company = 30,000 base tokens x plan multiplier x seats (+ purchased top-ups); resets at midnight server time; 429 when spent. (2) Burst per token on a rolling 2-second window. Search API burst is 10 requests per 2 seconds on every plan. v2 endpoints cost fewer tokens than v1. Burst headers: x-ratelimit-limit / -remaining / -reset; x-daily-requests-left (api\_token only).

## How to get an API key

Pipedrive uses API key. The steps below follow Pipedrive's own docs.

1.  Create a Pipedrive account. API access starts on the Lite plan.
2.  Personal API token from the user's Personal preferences > API; OAuth 2.0 for apps
3.  Send it with every request: header: x-api-token: <token> (or OAuth 2.0 bearer for marketplace apps).
4.  Make a first call: Add a person. Keep the key in an environment variable, never in the command.
    
    ```
    curl -X POST "https://api.pipedrive.com/api/v2/persons" \
      -H "x-api-token: $PIPEDRIVE_API_KEY" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{}'
    ```

## Strengths and limits

### Where it fits

-   SMB sales teams that run a deal pipeline and want a cheap per-seat CRM with an open API
-   Pushing persons/organizations/deals from enrichment pipelines into a rep-facing pipeline
-   Event-driven sync via webhooks v2 (create/change/delete on deals, persons, orgs, activities, projects)

### Where it falls short

-   High-volume bulk loads: no batch create/upsert for persons, organizations or deals (the only bulk endpoints are deal products and field options), and every call spends the daily token budget
-   Native duplicate prevention by domain/email on API writes (search first, then create)
-   Free usage: no free plan, 14-day trial only

### Worth knowing

-   Daily token budget is shared by every user and integration in the company account; at 100% all API calls return 429 until midnight server time (not the customer's time zone). Source: [pipedrive.readme.io/docs/core-api-concepts-rate-limiting](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/core-api-concepts-rate-limiting)
-   Burst limits are per token, and Search has its own fixed 10 requests per 2 seconds, so dedupe-by-search is the bottleneck. Source: [pipedrive.readme.io/docs/core-api-concepts-rate-limiting](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/core-api-concepts-rate-limiting)
-   Deprecated API v1 endpoints went out of support on 2026-08-01; use v2 where it exists (persons, organizations, deals, activities, products, pipelines, search, fields). Source: [developers.pipedrive.com/changelog](https://developers.pipedrive.com/changelog)
-   Pricing is geo-localised by price book, not by currency: the India-served page shows US$ 14/24/49/69 (annual) from a regional book, while the global book is US$ 14/39/59/79 annual and 24/49/79/99 monthly. Check the embedded 'country' field before quoting a capture. Sources: [pipedrive.com/en/pricing](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/pricing); [web.archive.org/web/20261016213148/https://www.pipedrive.com/en/pricing](http://web.archive.org/web/20261016213148/https://www.pipedrive.com/en/pricing) (verified 2026-10-25)
-   The pricing page's bot challenge is intermittent: plain Python with a Chrome UA got HTTP 200 twice on 2026-10-25, while curl was blocked earlier the same day (crm-free-options run) and the archive logged one 403 on 2026-08-29.

3 moreShow fewer

-   Signup needs a phone number on step 2 ('Please add your phone number'), so the no-card trial is not phone-free.
-   Two hosts, two v1 prefixes: OpenAPI v1 uses `https://api.pipedrive.com/v1/`..., the guides use `https://{COMPANYDOMAIN}.pipedrive.com/api/v1/`.... v2 is /api/v2 on both. Source: [developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/openapi.yaml](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/openapi.yaml); [pipedrive.readme.io/docs/core-api-concepts-authentication](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/core-api-concepts-authentication)
-   MCP calls draw on the same daily API token budget as every other integration in the company. Source: [pipedrive.com/en/features/mcp-server](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/features/mcp-server)

### Our take

We considered Pipedrive when choosing a free CRM for our own team and ruled it out because it has no free plan, only a 14-day trial.

## Before you build

Four things to settle first, each read off Pipedrive's own pages.

-   **Confirm the API is on your plan**API access starts on the Lite plan. Free tier: No free plan.
    
-   **Keep the key out of your code**API key. It is sent as: header: x-api-token: <token> (or OAuth 2.0 bearer for marketplace apps).
    
-   **Design around the rate limit**Two layers. (1) Daily token budget per company = 30,000 base tokens x plan multiplier x seats (+ purchased top-ups); resets at midnight server time; 429 when spent. (2) Burst per token on a rolling 2-second window. Search API burst is 10 requests per 2 seconds on every plan. v2 endpoints cost fewer tokens than v1. Burst headers: x-ratelimit-limit / -remaining / -reset; x-daily-requests-left (api\_token only).
    
-   **Know the catch before you scale**Daily token budget is shared by every user and integration in the company account; at 100% all API calls return 429 until midnight server time (not the customer's time zone). Source: [pipedrive.readme.io/docs/core-api-concepts-rate-limiting](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/core-api-concepts-rate-limiting)

Projects supported since 2026-04-10. Source: [pipedrive.readme.io/docs/guide-for-webhooks-v2](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/guide-for-webhooks-v2) (verified 2026-10-25)
